title: ai-handoff-protocol memory frontmatter
description: Frontmatter schema for files under memory/, per SPEC.md section 5.

id.description: Stable identifier for the fact/decision, unique within the project.

date.description: Absolute date (YYYY-MM-DD) this was established or last revised.

confidence.description: Whether this has been confirmed against a primary source, or is still provisional.

source.description: Where this came from: an evidence/ file path, a direct user statement, or an external document.

superseded_by.description: id of the memory entry that replaces this one, if any.
